title: Low-SNR Noisy Call & False Positive Suppression
description: Low signal-to-noise ratio (10dB SNR) call with ambient street traffic, cellular packet drop, and casual small talk where spurious alerts must be strictly suppressed.

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: Hello, thank you for holding. Can you hear me clearly through the static?

chunks.speaker: Customer
chunks.text: [background street traffic horn] Pretty good, just grabbing a cup of coffee near the avenue. Weather is okay. Can you check my file?

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: Glad to hear that. Opening your record right now, please hold for just a few seconds.

chunks.speaker: Customer
chunks.text: Sure thing, yeah take your time. [muffled ambient chatter]
